titles.title: I Will Offer Up My Life

properties.copyright: © 1994 Thankyou Music (Admin. by CopyCare Asia Ltd (Singapore Branch))

verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
I will offer up my life
In spirit and truth
Pouring out the oil of love
As my worship to You

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
In surrender I must give
My ev'ry part
Lord receive the sacrifice
Of a broken heart

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
Jesus what can I give
What can I bring
To so faithful a friend
To so loving a King

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
Savior what can be said
What can be sung
As a praise of Your name
For the things You have done

verse.name: c1c
verse.lines:
Oh my words could not tell
Not even in part
Of the debt of love
That is owed by this
Thankful heart

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
You deserve my every breath
For You've paid the great cost
Giving up Your life to death
Even death on a cross

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
You took all my shame away
There defeated my sin
Opened up the gates of heaven
And have beckoned me in
